introHtml: Evans is a trusted supplier known for durable, high-quality lanyards that hold up to daily wear in schools, hospitals, and corporate offices. Their woven and knit-in lanyards offer vibrant, fade-resistant printing for your logo or text. Whether you need breakaway safety lanyards for ID badges or antimicrobial options for healthcare, Evans provides reliable construction and consistent color matching. Choose from widths like 3/8" to 1" and materials from recycled polyester to nylon web. Customize with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for a professional look that lasts.
